title: Adam Robinson
description:
I've gone $0-$30m ARR/$15m profit in 5 years w/ zero funding as Founder/CEO of Retention.com and RB2B.

Last year I started RB2B.com and got it to $5m ARR in 12mo with a team of just 5 people.

As a side hustle I make the content I wish I had five years ago, before I started Retention.com.

You'll find two things on my channel:

I do a weekly workshop called "UnF*ck My Startup" with expert guest interviews like Sam Parr, Nathan Barry, and Jason Fried, and Shark Tank style audience interaction. 

I'm have an ongoing docuseries about the journey called "Billion Dollar Challenge".

Join my newsletter to follow along: 

https://newsletter.rb2b.com/
